User.title: User
User.description: Authenticated user profile with role-based access control.

role.description: User role: 'user' or 'admin'. Clients can only set 'user' on creation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user registered.

Shop.title: Shop
Shop.description: Public shop profile created by a home-based woman artisan in Pakistan (one shop per user at shops/{uid}).

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns the shop.

ownerEmail.description: Email address of the shop owner for administrative listing.

agreeToShareContact.description: Whether the user agreed to share her WhatsApp contact details publicly.

whatsappNumber.description: Optional WhatsApp phone number, stored only if agreeToShareContact is true.

visible.description: Whether the shop is visible in the public directory.

isHidden.description: Inverse of visible (!visible) for backward compatibility.

isSample.description: Whether the shop is a seeded sample shop.

products.description: List of 1 to 3 products with name, description, reason, price, and photos.

photos.description: Compressed data URLs of the artisan's work (1 to 4 photos).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shop was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shop was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile and role ('user' or 'admin') keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/shops/{shopId}.description: Stores each user's single shop keyed by owner UID (shops/{uid}).
